words: Can AI tell me which of our customers will open a support ticket next month? I have customer id, signup date, plan and region for each one, plus the tickets.

answers.target: customer opens at least one ticket in the next 30 days
answers.action: we staff the desk and reach out to heavy users early
answers.data_plan: customers table and the tickets table
answers.family: a prediction for each customer from the tables linked to it

check: Predicts who will open a support ticket, a different outcome from stopping or continuing to order, and they don't mention order columns.
